sentence: Describe the gap between FRED Brent spot (126.55 on 2026-10-14) and the BZ=F front-month future (105.92 on 2026-10-15) as the physical premium of dated Brent over futures that has held through 2026 on Iran/Hormuz risk, not as a data error, and flag it only if the gap changes sharply (note the two prints are from different dates).
